text: Past medical history: Unremarkable past medical history. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one younger sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern; given the fever, bone pain, and bruising in a 4-year-old, I will prioritize the most critical possibilities. Based on the symptoms of severe bone pain, fever, and bleeding tendencies, the leading concern is Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). I am requesting the CBC with differential, peripheral smear, and ESR/CRP results immediately to confirm this diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).
